$comment: Enforced high-water marks for knip's dead-code findings, per category. Policy, rationale and how to change a number live in docs/linting.md. This file is the source of truth for the numbers: scripts/check-deadcode.mjs owns the rules and never hard-codes one. A budget here is a tripwire, not a target — it is the ratchet that stops the pool growing while the cleanup slices drain it. Every category in `categories` is gated; one with no entry in `budgets` is gated at zero, which is where a category lands for good once a slice empties it.

categories.label: unused exports
categories.covers: an exported value with no importer outside its own file. The category the policy is about.

categories.label: unused exported types
categories.covers: the same, for a type, interface or enum declaration.

categories.label: unused files
categories.covers: a project file no entry point reaches, transitively.

categories.label: duplicate exports
categories.covers: one symbol exported twice from a file, so a rename can leave half the call sites behind.

categories.label: unlisted dependencies
categories.covers: an import that resolves only because a transitive install hoisted it into the tree.

categories.label: unresolved imports
categories.covers: an import specifier that resolves to nothing at all.

categories.label: unlisted binaries
categories.covers: a command a script shells out to that no manifest provides. Host tools belong in `knip.json`'s `ignoreBinaries` and in `config/host-tools.json`, not here.

categories.label: unused catalog entries
categories.covers: a `pnpm-workspace.yaml` catalog version no manifest references.

categories.label: unresolved catalog references
categories.covers: a manifest `catalog:` reference the catalog does not define.

categories.label: unused enum members
categories.covers: a member of an exported enum nothing reads.

categories.label: unused namespace members
categories.covers: a member reachable only through a namespace import nothing reads.

categories.label: circular dependencies
categories.covers: a cycle in the static value-import graph. knip does not report this one by default, so check-deadcode.mjs runs a second `--cycles` pass for it; oxlint's `import/no-cycle` gives the per-import-site diagnostic for the same static graph. See docs/linting.md.

changes.why: Deleted the four files nothing reached: the session adapters, session transport and web diff barrels, whose members every importer takes by direct path, and the unreferenced web EmptyState component.
serverOrigin.ts exported one function as both serverHttpOrigin and serverApiOrigin; dropped the alias and moved its six call sites in knowledgeBaseApi.ts and GoogleWorkspaceToolCard.tsx.
Pruned the 20 dead re-exports from the three barrels that are alive (session/log, session/runtime, piSdk); each declaration keeps its own separate finding where it is declared.
The same prune removed 22 dead type re-exports from session/log/index.ts, session/runtime/index.ts and piSdk/index.ts.

Drained to zero, so the category is gated for good: 225 of the 276 were merely over-exported and un-exporting them is the whole fix (noUnusedLocals owns them now), 7 were dead pass-through re-exports of a symbol that lives and is used elsewhere, and 44 were dead values the compiler named with TS6133 once unexported.

The same pass on the 184 type findings: 171 un-exported in place, 4 dead pass-through re-export specifiers, and 9 deleted on a TS6196 — eight of them the codeDeliveryRecipe *StepPayload family that literal payload construction plus agentExecutor's field-by-field reads superseded.

Widened the MEASUREMENT rather than the budget: knip.json now sets includeEntryExports on app/shared, whose files are all entry points, so protocol.ts's `export *` no longer counts as an importer for a wire symbol nothing else reads. 12 exports surfaced and were drained to keep the category at zero (3 un-exported, 9 deleted on a TS6133).

The same widening surfaced 21 type findings in app/shared: 14 un-exported in place, 7 deleted on a TS6196 — WorkflowRunDetail and the WorkflowStep/WorkflowEvent/WorkflowStepResult/WorkflowStepExecutor chain under it, the wire model for a per-run read that the run CARD projection replaced before it was ever plumbed to a client.

Declared at zero with no backlog: adopting `import-x/no-cycle` broke the 12 static cycles first, so the category opened empty. It is declared because the ESLint rule alone does NOT prove static acyclicity — with `allowUnsafeDynamicCyclicDependency: true` the first dynamic edge in a module aborts that module's traversal entirely (`return`, before the cycle check), so a purely static cycle between two modules that also hold lazy hub imports goes unreported. knip is what closes that.
